newsitem.title: USA: Station Casinos to open Kansas City casino.
newsitem.headline: Station Casinos to open Kansas City casino.

text.p: Station Casinos Inc said Thursday it received a gaming license from the Missouri Gaming Commission and will open its newest casino tonight.

The new casino, described as the nation's fourth-largest, has 140,000 square feet of gaming area, 3,000 slot machines and 190 gaming tables, Station Casinos said. It will also feature an 18-screen movie theater and video arcade center that are scheduled to open in April.
Station Casinos develops and operates casinos and entertainment complexes in several states.
Its shares were trading up 1/8 Thursday afternoon at nine.
